body.name: Directional tipping-inference handle
body.construction: \(\mathsf H_{\mathrm{inf}}\) starts from cross-fitted asymptotically linear estimators of the finite collection \((\lambda_x,p_x,r_{0,x},r_{1,x})_{x\in\mathcal X}\), composes their Gaussian limit with the Hadamard directional derivative of the certified legal-candidate minimum, and inverts a derivative-aware multiplier process for the level set \(L=0\); at stationary continua the handle replaces a finite active set by the support functional of the active semialgebraic set.
